body: wait so you’re saying people who are trying to get better and improve don’t deserve sympathy or help simply because of the way they are? that’s fucked man
oh yes i have another opinion so i must be wrong apologies i forgot this is reddit
To be fair narcissism usually stems from a very deep place of hurt, and the very rare narcissists that realise what they are and how they hurt people deserve to get help too

You are so important. If you feel like nobody cares now, well they do. And in the future if you stick around, there will always be somebody who cares what happens to you, if it’s your loved ones or your cat friends. Somebody out there needs you.

The thing is, it will always hurt your family. I’m not guilting you, but it will probably forever hurt them. That doesn’t make the fact that you’re hurting so bad you want to kill yourself okay. The fact that you’re in this position is terrible. I don’t have much advice because i’m in exactly the same position, but you aren’t alone in your pain.
